presentation.description: Adds a Skyrim-style compass bar at the top of your screen. Shows cardinal directions, tick marks, and nearby entity markers (players, enemies, gathering nodes, and more). Use /compass to toggle and /compass config to open settings.
presentation.summary: I got Moodles + Loci playing (somewhat) nice. Oh and theres a compass, too.
